fields.label: Interface sounds
fields.help: Audible feedback for remote navigation. Visual feedback stays available when sounds are off.

fields.label: Sound theme
fields.help: Left or Right chooses a theme to preview. Confirm applies it. Kodi packs use their own action sounds; unmapped actions stay silent.

fields.label: Interface sound level
fields.help: Left or Right adjusts this level separately from playback volume. System mute always silences interface sounds.

fields.label: Sounds during playback
fields.help: Off keeps navigation quiet while media is playing. External apps always control their own sounds.

fields.label: Preview theme
fields.help: Play a short move, select, Back and error sequence at the chosen interface level.

fields.label: Refresh Kodi themes
fields.help: Find installed UI sound packs in this profile’s Kodi add-ons and the system Kodi installation. No downloads or Kodi settings changes.
